findings.claim: MWA 賣給全國/區域水務經銷商，關係非獨家、無長期合約；兩大經銷商合計占毛銷售約 37%（FY2025）、38%（FY2024）、35%（FY2023）。經查未見最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的報導。
findings.excerpt: Although we have long-standing relationships with most of our key distributors, we typically do not have long-term contracts with them, including our two largest distributors, which together accounted for approximately 37%, 38% and 35% of our gross sales in 2025, 2024 and 2023 fiscal years, respectively.

note: 最大客戶為通路經銷商（Ferguson、Core & Main），非技術客戶，無第二供應商/in-house 事件的來源；搜尋未找到相關報導。
